name: KanDeck AI Chat — Webhook + Auth + Agent + Task tools

nodes.name: KanDeck Chat Webhook
nodes.notes: KanDeck's chat widget POSTs here. This node's path + your n8n base URL form the Production URL you paste into KanDeck -> App Settings -> AI Chat -> Webhook URL, e.g. https://<your-n8n-host>/webhook/kandeck-chat. allowedOrigins:'*' lets the browser call it (CORS). Requests continue to 'Check Auth'.

nodes.name: Check Auth
nodes.notes: AUTH GATE for the chat webhook. Replace REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_CHAT_TOKEN with a long random secret (keep the 'Bearer ' prefix) and set the SAME value in KanDeck -> App Settings -> AI Chat -> Bearer token. NOTE: this is the CHAT token (widget -> n8n). It is different from the KanDeck API KEY the tools use to call back INTO KanDeck. True -> continue; False -> 401.

nodes.name: Reject Unauthorized
nodes.notes: Returned when the Authorization header doesn't match.

nodes.name: Normalize
nodes.notes: KanDeck sends { source:'kandeck', sessionId, message, timestamp } as JSON; on the Webhook node that arrives under $json.body.

nodes.name: AI Agent

options.systemMessage:
You are the assistant embedded in KanDeck, a personal Trello-style kanban app. Help the user with their tasks, boards, priorities, and schedule. Be concise and friendly.

TOOLS
- "KanDeck Tasks" — look up the user's tasks. Use it for ANY question about what's on their board: what's due today, tomorrow, or this week, what's overdue, or what they've completed recently. It does all date math server-side, so just call it and report what it returns — NEVER guess or calculate dates yourself. Map the question to parameters:
    due = today | tomorrow | week (next 7 days) | overdue | none | any
    status = open | complete | all  (use complete for finished-task questions)
    completedWithin = <integer days>  (only for "what did I finish in the last N days")
    plus optional board, priority (urgent|high|medium|low), and q (text search).
  Examples: "what's due today" -> due=today, status=open. "anything overdue?" -> due=overdue, status=open. "what did I finish this week" -> status=complete, completedWithin=7.
- "Add KanDeck Task" — create a task. Use it whenever the user asks to add, create, capture, or jot down a task or reminder. Provide subject (required, what to do); optionally dueDate as an absolute YYYY-MM-DD (convert relative dates like "Friday" or "tomorrow" using today's date), priority (urgent|high|medium|low), and a short description. New tasks land in the user's KanDeck Inbox for them to file onto a board — tell them that after adding.

HOW TO ANSWER
- For task lookups, present a short, scannable list: task title, which board it's on, and the due date / days until due / how many days ago it was completed. Group sensibly (overdue first, then by due date). If nothing matches, say so plainly.
- Reading the user's tasks is NOT a change — don't ask for confirmation and don't announce that you're calling a tool.
- Use light formatting and the occasional emoji where it aids clarity. Keep it brief.

nodes.notes: The assistant, wired to the two KanDeck tools below. Its reply lands in $json.output.

parameters.content:
## KanDeck AI Chat

**Webhook -> auth -> AI agent (with KanDeck task tools) -> JSON reply.**

### Replace these placeholders
1. **REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_CHAT_TOKEN** (Check Auth) — a random secret; paste the same value into KanDeck App Settings -> AI Chat -> Bearer token.
2. **REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_KANDECK_URL** (both task tools) — your KanDeck base URL, e.g. `https://kandeck.example.com` (no trailing slash).
3. **REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_KANDECK_API_KEY** (both task tools) — generate in KanDeck App Settings -> API.
4. Attach your **OpenAI** (or other) model credential.
5. Confirm the **webhook path** and **Activate**.

### Two different secrets
- **Chat token**: widget -> n8n (keeps strangers off your webhook).
- **KanDeck API key**: n8n -> KanDeck (lets the tools read/create tasks).

The agent's system prompt already tells it how to map questions to the tools' parameters (due=today/week/overdue, status, completedWithin, etc.). Try: *"what's due today?"*, *"anything overdue?"*, *"add buy dog food due Friday"*.
